price_conversion.basis: Product of BFS published rounded annual-average CPI changes 2020 through 2025; approximate CPI rebasing, not construction or wage index rebasing.

source.edition: ASTRA eNISTRA 2022.2, HBEFA 5.1.003; workbook cached source tables, not scenario result cells

annualization.method: 300 equivalent days / native ASP class peak share; no congestion multiplier on vehicle-km

safety.source_cells: SI1n!AL46:AN48; rates CHF/1000 vehicle-km; risk year2005, prices2019; simplified method includes junctions

noise.source_cells: UW1n_Lärm!S306:Y308; CHF/vehicle-km prices2019; exclude tunnel and uninhabited lengths

air.source_cells: Bewertungssätze KNA!E34:E45,E53:E55; CHF/tonne except electricity CHF/MWh; prices2019

fleet_profile.outside_range: hold nearest endpoint; report year clipping
fleet_profile.method: ICE tailpipe weighted by1-electric share; abrasion covers all vehicles; upstream ICE/alternative-fuel factors weighted by fleet shares. National fleet and average road-class traffic conditions; no speed or queue-specific HBEFA recalculation.

sensitivity.interpretation: Factor scenarios, not a statistical confidence interval or guaranteed ordering of net benefits. VOSL and climate factors vary; rail assumptions vary. Road fleet base remains published national projection.

rail.basis: Illustrative regional electric multiple unit, national/international traction electricity mix sensitivity; not an operator quote. Nonenergy vehicle cost covers maintenance and rolling-stock resource use; excludes crew, traction energy, track access transfers and infrastructure O&M, which are separate.
rail.direct_rail_noise_and_safety: unmonetized; road mode-shift effects included separately; require railway incident/exposure inputs

reliability.reason: A deterministic assignment is not a travel-time variability model. NISTRA/EBeN reliability requires supported motorway/incident data; new single-lane bypass is outside the official simplified tool application.
